subject: Close slate reset: MAP milestones, eval gate conditions, and new delivery windows
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily@optiscale.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: OptiScale Procurement <procure@optiscale.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to shift MAP milestones and clarify eval gates

Sergio — thanks again for the session yesterday. After syncing internally, we need to request a modest shift to the mutual action plan: two of our internal stakeholders (security signoff and platform SRE readiness) have pushed their internal dates out by one sprint.

High-level asks:
- Move the final acceptance window by 10 business days (target close moves from 2027-05-14 to 2027-05-26).
- Add a formal 'SRE readiness' eval gate before the production rollout (we've sketched acceptance criteria in the attached Evaluation-criteria_v2.xlsx).
- Confirm whether the MAP change triggers any pricing or delivery exceptions (we are particularly sensitive to reserved capacity start dates).

I attached an updated MAP (OptiScale-MAP_v3.pdf) with annotated milestone dates. Can you confirm a feasible re-baselined timeline from your side and whether Redwood can provide a short-term mitigation (e.g., temporary capacity overlap) if we need it? Procurement is standing by for contract change instructions if needed.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Chen
VP, Product Operations
OptiScale

Attachments: OptiScale-MAP_v3.pdf (PDF, 1 page, annotated), Evaluation-criteria_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 1 sheet)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@optiscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to shift MAP milestones and clarify eval gates

Emily — appreciate the heads-up and the annotated MAP. We've reviewed the attachments and sketched an internal adjustment plan. Summary below.

Proposal (high level):
- Re-baseline: move target close to 2027-05-26 (matches your ask).
- Eval gates: add SRE readiness gate before cutover; we will require the SRE checklist to be marked complete and one load smoke test (500 concurrent sessions) passing.
- Short-term mitigation: Redwood can provide a 7-day overlap of reserved capacity at no additional charge to cover the cutover window, provided procurement signs the amendment within five business days.

Impact & conditions:
- Pricing: the reserved capacity start date shifts but we will honor the originally quoted rate if the amendment to the contract is executed by 2027-05-06.
- Delivery: feature freeze for integration changes remains 5 business days before the new cutover date (2027-05-19). Any changes after that may require a second validation window.

I've attached a MAP delta summary (MAP-change-log.txt) in the thread and asked Neha to run through the SRE checklist and confirm the smoke-test schedule. Marissa — can you confirm finance approvals on the overlap credit?

Next steps:
1) OptiScale to confirm acceptance of the SRE gate criteria (reply with simple ack).
2) Procurement to route contract amendment (DocuSign link) or confirm timeline.
3) Redwood to schedule smoke test and provision overlap capacity once amendment is initiated.

Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Quoted from the original email:
> After syncing internally, we need to request a modest shift to the mutual action plan...

Attachments referenced: MAP-change-log.txt (plain text, 1KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request to shift MAP milestones and clarify eval gates

Sergio / Neha — looped in to confirm approvals and logistics. Quick notes from finance:
- We can offer the 7-day overlap credit as a one-time concession. Need a short memo for the file (I will draft).
- We require procurement to sign the amendment by 2027-05-06 to protect the rate.

Neha — can you confirm availability for a smoke test slot between 2027-05-20 and 2027-05-24? Also, please confirm the specific SRE checklist items Redwood requires so Emily has them inline in her ticketing system. If any additional infra work is needed (network peering or firewall exceptions) we should document the owner and SLA.

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Finance & Deals
Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@optiscale.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Final confirmation: re-baselined MAP & acceptance steps (OptiScale)

Emily — thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming the SRE criteria in your note earlier today. This email confirms Redwood's commitments and the final steps to close on the new schedule.

Re-baselined dates (agreed):
- Integration feature freeze: 2027-05-19
- SRE readiness gate / smoke test window: 2027-05-20 through 2027-05-24 (slot to be confirmed by Neha)
- Final acceptance window / target close: 2027-05-26

Redwood commitments:
- 7-day reserved capacity overlap (no charge) covering 2027-05-26 +/- 3 days, contingent on signed amendment by 2027-05-06.
- We will provide the SRE checklist and a pre-filled runbook by 2027-05-03.
- Single smoke test (500 concurrent sessions) scheduled once OptiScale confirms the test window; Redwood will staff an SRE engineer and an account rep during the test.

OptiScale asks for procurement: please route the contract amendment to the DocuSign link below. If procurement cannot meet the 2027-05-06 sign date, we will still execute the overlap but must move to a billed model for the extra days (we will provide an exact estimate).

Links & attachments:
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/deals/OPTS-2026-37
- DocuSign amendment: https://docusign.company/OPTS-2026-37/amend
- MAP (final): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bOptiScale-MAP

If there are any objections from procurement or legal, please flag immediately and loop Laura Bennett (legal) so we can triage.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
